item.title: Ampersands
item.description: I am a fan of www.simpledesktops.com so it was a thrill to have curator Tom Watson put up my White Ampersands design. The ampersand was handlettered with a round nib and black India ink. I then scanned it and cleaned it up in AI. No, not artificial intelligence.
